increment_paragraph: **JUMPED-SHADOW-FORMAL-READINGS** (USER DECISION 2026-11-25, "launch the JUMPED-SHADOW-FORMAL-READINGS card"; gateway rule 86, extended; `QCore.JumpedShadowFormalReadings`; [report](../../reports/jumped-shadow-formal-readings/README.md)). Discharges `JUMPED-SHADOW-FORMAL-READINGS` (registered by NAME-KEYED-HOLDER-SHADOWING). Probed every other consumer of a formal's spelling with jumped-over shadows (a `switch` before its first label, a `goto`) and unrecognized declarations (`__attribute__`, `_Alignas`, `__typeof__`, parenthesized, enumeration constants). Container publication rooted at a jumped shadow, rule 38's descriptor-cell `formal` closure and W4 entry custody (a release through the shadow read as the formal's) reached `Safe` that only the internal certificate check stopped (CJ1, CJ2, CJ4, DCJ1-DCJ3, WDJ1, WDJ2, WJ1, WJ2). A derived local of container publication (`h = holder->list`) shadowed by a jumped or inner-block local was read as the caller's container and was `Safe` outright (CJ5, CJ6). The counted-user pass recorded a `Held` clause for an unrecognized shadow (KU1, KU2, KDU1); slot moves and member custody attribution did not admit. `CallerFormals` is now read by declaration where it is built (a stable formal only where its name is one declaration, a derived local only where its own name is one `VarDecl` and its root stays stable), the counted-user pass's stable formals likewise, and a formal that is not one declaration in Clang's reading refuses its function at the entry, on every path; without Clang's reading, no derived local is read and the entry refuses where the body may hide a shadow from the lexical guard. Lean: `no_verdict_becomes_safe` (entry guard and narrowed reading `Safe` imply census `Safe`), with the CJ1, CJ5 and WDJ1 witnesses. `tests/jumped_shadow_formal_readings.rs` (1 passed, 6 failed at base; 7 passed at tip). Opt-in `current --monkey-linked` over Fluent Bit 046accf6, each side on its own tree and binary: base 4fef267f4 and tip befb0df69 both 1,187/2/3,607/8, no status move; two librdkafka rows (`rd_kafka_CreateAclsResponse_parse`, `rd_kafka_DeleteAclsResponse_parse`) gained leaves only, `Unknown -> Unknown`, within the prediction. Scoped gate at befb0df69: every step 0 except the Rust suite (10,122 passed, 6 failed, exactly the six known K5-LOCAL-ORIGIN-ALIASES base failures); 510 Lean audits; 807 Python tests. Pinned routes are not runnable on the host; no move predicted. No follow-up registered.
